limitations: Odd orders at least three; regular labelled tournament support; only first-degree edge characters. The uniform tight spectrum does not extend automatically to nonuniform sampling. Historical equivalence risks remain.
scientific_integrity: All-integer-affine-span and covariance identities have complete proofs; finite checker only corroborates at orders three and five. Novelty assessed under bounded literature access; no independent audit.
title: Integral tight Fourier sampling and tree-complement designs for regular tournaments
